- **Critical — mobile caption is invisible:** At 390px, `@media(max-width:600px)` applies and sets `.responsive-caption { opacity: 0 }`. The `<figcaption>` text “Revenue excludes refunds.” becomes fully transparent, giving an effective visual contrast of **1:1** against the white background. It also retains layout space because `opacity` does not remove the element. Remove this rule or keep `opacity: 1`.

- **Accessibility — chart content is excluded from assistive technology:** `<div aria-hidden="true">Chart</div>` displays “Chart” visually but removes it from the accessibility tree. Screen-reader users receive the caption but not the visible chart content. Remove `aria-hidden="true"` or provide an accessible chart description associated with the figure.

No undersized tap targets are present because the page contains no interactive controls. The declared 16px body text and 1.5 line height are acceptable.
